_meta.memberships_note: REAL 2026 dues (Diana's '2026 Annual Membership Dues' sheet, sent by Felicia Aug 3 2026). Dues are set by employee count; every NEW member also pays a ONE-TIME $50 activation fee, so `amount` (what join-page checkout charges) = dues + activation. `dues`/`activation` exist so pages can show the honest breakdown; min/maxEmployees drive the join page's count→price lookup (maxEmployees null = no upper bound). Non-profits with 50 or fewer employees get the sheet's discounted $100 rate ('a discounted rate of $100 is offered to those with 50 or fewer employees' — read as a flat rate, flagged to Felicia for confirmation Aug 3); over 50 employees the general schedule applies, per the sheet. RENEWALS never come through here — the pay portal uses /api/pay-items — so the activation fee stays first-year-only.
_meta.source: 2026 Annual Membership Dues sheet (Diana via Felicia, Aug 3 2026). Donation presets are amounts actually received in legacy transaction history (2018–2026).
